It feels as if the first rays of morning are mixed in, and after drinking, you can sense the gentle, flowing rhythm of the earth.

Typically made from <style="highlight">grancia</style> and <style="highlight">coconfruit</style>.

"仿佛将第一缕晨光揉进去，饮下后能感觉到万物的韵律悄然流转。
一般由<style="highlight">半美</style>和<style="highlight">裂息果</style>制成。"
